bull.b: Conversion of design wins into mass production provides tangible evidence of customer adoption and a path from engineering activity to recurring product revenue. The production pipeline extends into 2027, supporting multi-quarter visibility and potential operating scale.

Strong product-led growth indicates improving demand for Sequans’ cellular IoT solutions rather than reliance solely on one-time licensing revenue. If sustained, higher product volumes can broaden the revenue base and improve utilization as customers advance connected-device programs.

Exiting Bitcoin and eliminating convertible debt simplify the capital structure and reduce exposure to cryptocurrency volatility. A clearer balance sheet should let management focus financial resources on scaling cellular IoT and software-defined radio opportunities while improving stakeholder visibility.

bear.b: Ongoing operating cash consumption means the business is not yet self-funding its growth and must continue managing liquidity while product revenue scales. Sustained burn can constrain investment flexibility and make the path to the stated H1 2027 breakeven target more execution-sensitive.

Compressed gross margin and continuing operating losses show that increased product revenue has not yet translated into durable earnings power. The lower-margin mix and need for further cost reductions leave profitability dependent on scale, pricing, licensing, and disciplined expense execution.

The NYSE deficiency creates a structural corporate risk that requires management to restore compliance within a defined cure process. Continued listing uncertainty can distract leadership, complicate access to capital, and add pressure while the operating turnaround remains incomplete.
